evidence_quotes.agenda: 'Do you have any specific concerns or stressors about the moving process in general?' — asked, but only after full logistics intake, right before pricing.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A applied — customer answered 'No, I don't' to the concerns question.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: None of the 5 lines reached — and notably, the entire differentiator block (damage coverage, Meet Your Mover, On-Time Guarantee) got skipped in this call after a customer interruption about 'labor only' pricing, so none of Sheets 1/2/3/4 land here either.

top_strength: Stayed patient and re-clarified cleanly through a couple of real mishearings ('eight and a half hour minimum' vs. 'two and a half', 'laser' vs. 'labor') without losing the thread of the call.
coaching_note: The customer's interruption mid-pitch knocked out the entire differentiator block (damage coverage, Meet Your Mover, On-Time Guarantee never got said) — worth building a habit of circling back to any dropped differentiator before moving to the close, especially since this customer ended the call still shopping around. Total rounded from a raw component sum of 44.5 (half-point from a Stage 2 split).
